Emma (CS): Weekly Meridian account health check-in — error breakdown and top failing endpoints.
Emma (CS): TL;DR: overall error rate 0.95% (+0.2% WoW). 5xx = 55% of errors, timeouts = 30%, rate-limits = 15%.
alerts-bot: [ALERT] 2024-06-18T03:10Z meridian-prod: 5xx spike on /v1/generate (rolling 5m)
Raj (Infra): saw correlation with autoscaler scale-down at 03:08Z. Node churn + cold KV cache -> 5xx/timeouts.
James (SE): sharing quick breakdown:
```
/v1/generate    5xx    2150  (65% of 5xx)
/v1/chat        5xx     480  (14%)
/v1/generate    timeout 320
/auth/token     rate_limit 210
/ingest/batch   timeout 110
```
Marta (Support): customer message queued — they reported intermittent failures since last Tuesday.
Emma (CS): notable: spend is steady, but latency p50 up 20ms and p95 up 120ms during spike windows.
Raj (Infra): immediate mitigation: bumped meridian-prod min_replicas to 4 and disabled preemptible nodes for the pool.
James (SE): quick config patch deployed: adjust batching window to 8ms, KV warmup on deploy. Monitoring flagged.
Emma (CS): action items:
- Raj: keep min_replicas=4 + monitor for 12h
- James: validate no regression on throughput and post logs
- Marta: send customer note + meeting Wed 11:00 PT
- Emma: follow-up in next weekly check
Marta (Support): will include the endpoint list and screenshots in the customer note.
Raj (Infra): I'll also open a short runbook PR for autoscaler guardrails.
Emma (CS): thanks all — assign owners in the ticket. :thumbsup:
James (SE): noted, will report back with metrics in thread.
alerts-bot: [ALERT CLEARED] 2024-06-18T05:20Z meridian-prod: 5xx rate back to baseline
Emma (CS): closing loop: current 24h error delta down to +0.02%. will re-evaluate at next check-in.
